title: A Autopsy for the Confession
author: Oscar Reyes
blurb: Yara Zhou, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
